Tests reasm insert, publish, slot MR, and repair replay signature helpers.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_reasm` reassembly code. It creates a workspace, builds an `fd_reasm_t` object, and then runs several test cases that insert FEC records in different orders and with different parent links. The tests check how records move through the internal sets `ancestry`, `frontier`, `orphaned`, and `subtrees`, and they verify that `fd_reasm_out()` returns records in the expected order.

The file also tests `fd_reasm_publish()` and the `slot_mr` root handling logic. In `test_publish()`, it checks that publishing a new root removes older records and keeps the expected records in the active sets. In `test_slot_mr()`, it checks that the reassembler uses the slot message root field when it resolves parent links. The `main()` function starts the runtime, creates the workspace, runs all tests, and then checks the `fd_disco_repair_replay_sig()` helper functions that encode and decode repair replay signal fields.
